Analytics Neon projects are now pinned to one Postgres major everywhere (ANALYTICS_PG_VERSION = 18, separate from the minds-<env> projects' default): dev auto-provisioning creates analytics projects at that major, and the deploy flow verifies the tier's analytics ops database matches it before running analytics migrations -- catching a console-created shared-tier bringup at the wrong version before anything touches it. Prompted by the production bringup landing on Postgres 18 while staging's scripted bringup produced 17; staging was recreated at 18 to match.
